name: AIReg-Bench-human
description: A human-annotated benchmark for evaluating model responses on AI regulation / compliance style prompts. It contains prompts and human judgments about correctness, compliance, or helpfulness of model outputs, intended to measure models' understanding of regulatory concepts and safe/acceptable responses. Useful for assessing alignment and policy-aware behavior in text models.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited community adoption, primarily hosted on Hugging Face and used in small-scale safety/regulation evaluations.
